# Soil test

One sample from each bed, taken in February.

## Results

| Bed | pH | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 6.8 | Good |
| 2 | 6.5 | Good |
| 3 | 5.9 | Add lime |
| 4 | 6.6 | Good |

Bed 3 is the sour one. Lime it before the squash go in.
